WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY powerstatus
),
status_shares AS (
  SELECT
    powerstatus,
    telescope_count,
    100.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share_pct
  FROM status_counts
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share_pct) AS avg_share_pct
  FROM status_shares
)
SELECT
  SUM(ss.telescope_count) AS total_telescope_count,
  AVG(ss.share_pct) AS average_share_pct,
  AVG(ss.share_pct - a.avg_share_pct) AS average_amount_above_average_share_pct
FROM status_shares AS ss
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE ss.share_pct > a.avg_share_pct;
